ul.li: Report a problem or an idea from the main menu: Nuntius sends it to GitHub with your own token or opens the filled-in issue form.
Notifications arrive while Nuntius is closed, through a UnifiedPush distributor such as KUnifiedPush.
Nuntius has its own app icon: a speech bubble with a messenger's wing.

description.p: First build of Nuntius, a fork of Fractal.
